prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one coffee cup preset recognition icon for a Material 3 Android calculator, ultimately displayed at 24, 28 and 34 px. This is a reference-guided creation, not a screenshot edit. Image 1 is only the vessel anatomy reference: discard all its colors, texture and shading. Image 2 is the app style reference: match the filled, rounded monochrome Coffee, Water and In cup symbols, but do not draw the app UI. Image 3 is the current five-icon family for coherence and distinction; draw only the requested single vessel. Style: a bold flat 2D filled silhouette with smooth rounded edges, one solid near-black ink (#30323b), zero gradients or strokes. Front view with a restrained elliptical view of the open mouth, like the native calculator cup. Large solid body and generous, genuinely transparent rim/handle cutouts that will survive at 24 px. Put the complete icon in the center of a square transparent canvas with even 15% margins; do not crop. No words, border, tile, shadows, steam, beans, fluid texture, reflection, extra vessels, decorative detail or watermarks. Transparent background and all internal empty spaces must have true alpha transparency. Distinguish the vessel through body silhouette and its necessary anatomy, not extra small markings. Subject: a petite espresso demitasse, small rounded handle on the right, and a detached shallow saucer clearly beneath it with a generous transparent gap. Cup body approximately as wide as it is tall; smaller body than a mug, without relying on shrinking the whole icon. The shallow wide saucer is the primary recognition cue. Broad single oval mouth opening; handle opening at least as thick as rim opening. Only one cup and one saucer.
